script.when: Daddy.

Baan Chang Cafe in Krabi (activities/boat-trip/chang/, plan: thailand/baan-chang.md): the sign, the chocolate milk, the boardwalk and the elephants. The elephants don't talk (rumbles, trumpets, squeals); Daddy and Mommy react in their own voices, and Sparkle says the names, what's new, and what to do after a while with nothing done. Daddy's "Where to, Captain Kaylee?", "Everybody, pose!", "One, two, three, cheese!" and "Pai!" are the bay's.
